Approach

Every asset starts as a real reference — a scanned PCB, a studio livery, a creature's silhouette — then gets pushed through block-out, high-poly, bake, and shade until it holds up in-engine, not just in a turntable.

Statement

I'm a 3D animation student specializing in hard-surface modeling, creature art, and stylized / NPR shading. I like assets with a reason for every panel line and every scar — whether that's a spacecraft hull or a spider's carapace.

Outside coursework, I take builds apart to understand them — currently reverse-engineering a mechanical keyboard PCB in FreeCAD to design its case from scratch.
